DOCUMENTATION.TITLE: User Manual
DOCUMENTATION.IOTMISSIONSTART: Mission Trigger Based on IoT Scenarios
DOCUMENTATION.CENTRALIOT: Centralized Management of Buttons and Sensors
DOCUMENTATION.INTRO1: izyGlam's AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robot) Management platform represents a major advancement in the field of automated management of mobile robots within a warehouse. Developed in collaboration with Bosch's renowned technology, this solution pushes the boundaries of logistical efficiency by offering a comprehensive suite of innovative features.
DOCUMENTATION.INNOVATION1: The platform fully leverages Bosch's robot technology, known for its reliability and advanced performance. The autonomous robots integrated into the platform provide precise navigation and secure interaction with their environment. This cutting-edge technology, combined with the IRIIS software suite, ensures smooth mission execution, minimizing interruptions and optimizing the overall productivity of the warehouse.
DOCUMENTATION.OPTIOPERATIONS1: The platform offers a range of features aimed at optimizing all logistical operations. From real-time tracking of robot status to complete visualization of stocks in the supermarket, and proactive mission management through predefined scenarios, every aspect of logistics is meticulously considered. This enables users to make informed decisions, anticipate needs, and adjust operations accordingly.
DOCUMENTATION.OPTIOPERATIONS2: Users can access intuitive dashboards providing detailed information on relevant parameters. This feature allows warehouse operators and managers to quickly respond to unexpected changes, anticipate potential issues, and optimize operational performance.
DOCUMENTATION.TRANSPARENTINTEGRATON1: Seamless integration with Bosch and IRIIS interfaces significantly simplifies the daily management of the platform. Users can directly access the Bosch interface to finely configure robot parameters, adjust navigation behaviors, and monitor real-time sensor data. Simultaneously, the interface with IRIIS enables centralized mission management, facilitating resource coordination and real-time data-driven decision-making. This synergy between interfaces ensures a seamless user experience and optimal utilization of all features offered by izyGlam's AMR platform.
DOCUMENTATION.TRANSPARENTINTEGRATON2: izyGlam's  platform represents a perfect symbiosis of technological innovation, intelligent automation, and optimization of logistical operations. It offers a comprehensive and scalable solution to address current challenges in warehouse management, positioning izyGlam as a leader in the field of autonomous robotics and connected devices.
DOCUMENTATION.RUNNINGMISSIONS1: The 'Running Missions' KPI represents the current number of missions being executed by izyGlam's AMR platform's autonomous robots. This metric provides an instant view of ongoing operational activity, allowing warehouse managers to monitor current workload and ensure efficient mission execution.
DOCUMENTATION.OPERATIONALROBOTS1: The 'Operational Robots' KPI indicates the total number of robots ready for deployment. This metric provides an immediate indication of the operational capacity of the robot fleet. It is crucial for mission planning, enabling users to effectively allocate tasks based on the number of available robots.
DOCUMENTATION.AMRACTIF1: The 'Active AMRs' KPI represents the number of Autonomous Mobile Robots currently in motion. This metric offers real-time visibility into robot activity, allowing operators to track their progress in the warehouse and ensure optimal resource utilization.
DOCUMENTATION.AMRCHARGING1: The 'AMRs Charging' KPI indicates the number of Autonomous Mobile Robots currently undergoing charging. This metric is essential for effective management of robot energy, minimizing downtime associated with recharging.
DOCUMENTATION.AMRDEFAULT1: The 'AMRs in Default' KPI represents the number of Autonomous Mobile Robots currently reported as faulty. This metric provides an immediate indication of operational issues, allowing for quick intervention to resolve technical problems and minimize interruptions.
DOCUMENTATION.MISSIONSDONE1: The 'Missions Accomplished' KPI indicates the total number of missions successfully completed by autonomous robots. This metric provides a measure of the overall efficiency of the platform, reflecting the ability of robots to reliably accomplish their assigned tasks.
DOCUMENTATION.INCIDENTSCOUNT1: The 'Number of Incidents' KPI represents the total number of incidents or issues reported during a defined period. This metric provides an overview of the operational stability of the platform, allowing managers to take corrective measures to minimize the risk of interruptions.
DOCUMENTATION.AVGTIME1: The 'Average Time' KPI represents the average time required to complete a mission. This metric provides valuable insights into the operational performance of robots, allowing a detailed assessment of the efficiency of the logistical process.
DOCUMENTATION.AVGWAITINGTIME1: The 'Average Waiting Time' KPI represents the average time that robots spend waiting between missions. This metric offers an overview of the efficiency of the mission planning process, identifying optimization opportunities to reduce waiting times.
DOCUMENTATION.MAXWAITINGTIME1: The 'Maximum Waiting Time' KPI indicates the maximum duration that robots can spend waiting between missions. This metric helps identify exceptional situations where waiting times may become critical, guiding necessary adjustments in mission planning.
DOCUMENTATION.MISSIONSEVOL1: The 'Evolution of Mission Count' KPI provides an overview of long-term trends by showing how the number of missions changes over time. This metric allows managers to anticipate future demand and adjust operational capacity accordingly.
DOCUMENTATION.ROBOTPRODUCTIVITY1: The 'Robot Productivity' KPI measures the overall efficiency of robots by quantifying the amount of work accomplished relative to available resources. This metric is essential for evaluating the operational efficiency of the platform as a whole.
DOCUMENTATION.MISSIONSPERHOURCOUNT1: The 'Number of Missions per Hour' KPI provides a measure of operational productivity by indicating how many missions are executed on average each hour. This metric allows for the assessment of overall platform performance on an hourly basis, facilitating planning and resource optimization based on temporal trends.
DOCUMENTATION.MISSIONSPERHOURCOUNT2: These KPIs offer a comprehensive set of measures allowing users to monitor and optimize all operations of izyGlam's  platform. Each metric has been carefully selected to provide crucial insights into the performance, reliability, and efficiency of autonomous robot management in a warehouse environment.
DOCUMENTATION.BOSCHINTRO: Access to the Bosch interface within izyGlam's  platform serves as a gateway to precise and personalized configuration of autonomous robot parameters. This interface offers a range of sophisticated tools that allow users to fully leverage the advanced features offered by Bosch's robot technology. Here is a more detailed explanation of the key features of this interface.
DOCUMENTATION.FINEROBOTCONF1: The Bosch interface offers fine configuration of robot parameters, allowing operators and managers to define specific behaviors for each robot. This includes navigation parameters such as speed, acceleration, and obstacle avoidance strategies. Users can adjust these parameters based on the particular characteristics of their warehouse, ensuring precise adaptation to operational conditions.
DOCUMENTATION.TEMPLATECREATION1: The mission template creation feature significantly streamlines the mission planning process. Users can define pre-configured mission templates, integrating specific parameters, predefined destinations, and particular conditions. This feature accelerates robot deployment by allowing quick and reproducible mission planning, reducing the time required for manual configuration.
DOCUMENTATION.REALTIMEROBOT1: The Bosch interface offers an interactive map for tracking the progress of robots in real-time. This feature provides a visual view of the current location of each robot in the warehouse, facilitating operational monitoring. Managers can quickly identify the position of robots, ongoing missions, and anticipate future trajectories. This real-time tracking capability contributes to proactive operations management, allowing immediate adjustments in case of changing needs.
DOCUMENTATION.REALTIMEROBOT2: Access to the Bosch interface within izyGlam's AMR platform goes beyond just configuring robots. It offers a comprehensive set of tools that enable users to customize, plan, and effectively monitor the operations of autonomous robots. This seamless integration with Bosch technology ensures optimal use of robot capabilities, contributing to automated and efficient warehouse management.
DOCUMENTATION.IRIISINTRO: The IRIIS interface within izyGlam's  platform paves the way for advanced management of sensors and buttons in an agnostic manner. This interface offers an integrated approach, allowing users to configure and supervise IoT (Internet of Things) devices centrally. Here is a more in-depth explanation of the essential features of this interface.
DOCUMENTATION.AGNOSTICSENSORS1: The IRIIS interface supports agnostic sensor management, meaning it is compatible with a variety of sensors from different manufacturers. This agnosticism allows significant flexibility in choosing sensors, facilitating the integration of specialized devices based on the specific needs of the warehouse. Users can configure and monitor various types of sensors, such as proximity sensors, temperature sensors, or load sensors, to optimize real-time data collection.
DOCUMENTATION.IOTMISSIONSTART1: One of the key features of the IRIIS interface is the ability to trigger missions based on defined conditions in IoT scenarios. These scenarios can be pre-configured to react to specific events detected by sensors. For example, a scenario could be set to trigger a movement mission to a specific area of the warehouse when the temperature exceeds a defined threshold. This proactive approach allows advanced automation of missions, optimizing responsiveness and overall operational efficiency.
DOCUMENTATION.CENTRALIOT1: The IRIIS interface offers efficient centralization of button and sensor management. Users can configure and supervise these devices from a centralized location, simplifying maintenance and monitoring. This centralization also enables smooth coordination of actions triggered by buttons and sensors, contributing to consistent mission execution throughout the warehouse.
DOCUMENTATION.CENTRALIOT2: The IRIIS interface is an essential component of izyGlam's AMR platform by providing advanced, agnostic, and centralized management of sensors and buttons. Its seamless integration with IoT scenarios allows intelligent automation of missions, creating an adaptive operational environment responsive to changes in the warehouse.
DOCUMENTATION.VISUELVIEW1: The Supermarket page offers an immersive visual experience by presenting a detailed graphical representation of the warehouse aisles. This real-time visualization allows users to intuitively monitor stock status and stock movements. Here is a more in-depth analysis of the key features of this visual view.
DOCUMENTATION.ALLEESTATE1: Each location in the supermarket is meticulously color-coded to reflect the presence of a dolly. This visual coding provides an instant representation of the current location of items, allowing users to quickly locate products in the warehouse. Additionally, identifiers of items contained in each dolly are clearly indicated, facilitating precise stock management. This feature contributes to effective operational supervision and proactive response to changing warehouse needs.
DOCUMENTATION.QUANTITYTOPRODUCE1: Each aisle is equipped with a visual indicator that offers a quick estimate of production needs. Based on parameters defined in the configuration file, this feature provides a clear indication of the required production volume based on the current warehouse conditions. This proactive approach allows users to make informed decisions about production planning, adjusting stock levels according to current demand. Thus, this feature contributes to efficient resource management and optimization of logistical operations.
DOCUMENTATION.QUANTITYTOPRODUCE2: The Supermarket page offers more than just a visualization of warehouse aisles. It is an essential tool for precise stock management, providing users with a detailed view of dolly locations, item identifiers, and production needs. This real-time visual representation contributes to proactive warehouse management, allowing increased responsiveness to demand changes and constant optimization of logistical operations.
DOCUMENTATION.KANBAN1: The Kanban page plays a central role in managing dolly orders, offering an essential solution to maintain a smooth logistics chain within the warehouse. This section provides an in-depth introduction to the features and benefits of the Kanban page in izyGlam's  platform.
DOCUMENTATION.TASKMANAGEMENT1: The feature of task creation and deletion offers valuable flexibility in production management. Users can quickly create new tasks to meet specific production needs, disregarding predefined rules. Similarly, the ability to delete tasks provides immediate responsiveness to changes in demand or production priorities. This feature allows dynamic adaptation of production planning, ensuring agile and efficient management of dolly orders.
DOCUMENTATION.ORDERFOLLOW1: The Kanban page offers real-time visual tracking of the current status of each order. This feature allows users to quickly view where each order stands in the production process. Clear indicators show whether an order is pending, in progress, or completed, providing an instant overview of the logistics chain's progress. This tracking feature contributes to proactive order management, minimizing delays, and optimizing delivery times.
DOCUMENTATION.ORDERFOLLOW2: The adaptability feature is at the core of the Kanban page. Users can adjust the 'RAF' (To Be Done) parameter when creating tasks, allowing precise adaptation of production based on specific current needs. Moreover, the ability to transfer tasks from one production line to another with a simple 'Drag & Drop' offers remarkable flexibility in resource reallocation. This adaptability allows quick response to demand fluctuations and optimization of task distribution, contributing to effective and dynamic production management.
DOCUMENTATION.ORDERFOLLOW3: The Kanban page is a strategic tool in managing dolly orders. Its task creation/deletion, order tracking, and adaptability features offer a holistic approach to ensuring a smooth and responsive logistics chain to constant changes in the warehouse.
DOCUMENTATION.SCENARINTRO: The Scenario page is a cornerstone in the automated management of robot missions within izyGlam's  platform. By automating missions in response to specific events, users can create scenarios for proactive operations management, thus optimizing the efficiency of the logistics chain and internal processes.
DOCUMENTATION.IOTSTATE1: The IoT State-based trigger feature offers exceptional flexibility in creating automated scenarios. Users can define precise conditions based on sensor data, allowing the creation of scenarios responsive to changes in the environment. For example, a scenario could be triggered as soon as the temperature in a specific warehouse area exceeds a defined threshold, initiating a mission to move temperature-sensitive products to a more suitable area. This feature contributes to intelligent automation of missions, ensuring an immediate response to operational condition variations.
DOCUMENTATION.MISSIONTEMPLATE1: The simplicity of mission selection via templates is a powerful characteristic of the Scenario page. Users can easily associate a scenario with a specific mission that will be triggered once the defined conditions are met. This feature significantly streamlines the scenario creation process, providing an intuitive way to specify actions to be taken in response to particular events. Thus, the creation and management of automated missions become accessible to all users, even without extensive programming expertise.
DOCUMENTATION.PRIO1: The ability to define the priority of each scenario allows fine and strategic management of automated operations. Users can assign priority levels based on the relative importance of scenarios, ensuring that critical missions are executed first in case of conflict between multiple scenarios. This feature offers valuable flexibility in prioritizing automated missions, ensuring optimal execution even in complex situations.
DOCUMENTATION.PRIO2: The Scenario page offers a powerful solution for automating robot missions in response to specific events. IoT State-based triggers, the simplicity of associating mission templates, and the ability to define priority contribute to proactive and intelligent operations management, positioning izyGlam's AMR platform at the forefront of advanced logistics automation.
DOCUMENTATION.USERACCOUNT1: The User page offers a comprehensive set of tools for efficient account management within izyGlam's  platform. This section focuses on the creation and assignment of roles, providing administrators with precise control over user access and permissions.
DOCUMENTATION.ACCOUNTCREATION1: The account creation feature simplifies the process of adding new users to the platform. Administrators can easily add team members, supervisors, or other stakeholders by specifying key information such as name, email address, and other relevant details. This simplicity in account creation ensures a quick integration of new users, ensuring a smooth transition when expanding the team or adding new collaborators.
DOCUMENTATION.ACCOUNTCREATION2: You will, of course, have the ability to delete user accounts at will, except for the one currently logged in.
DOCUMENTATION.ROLEGIVE1: Role assignment is an essential component of account management on the User page. Administrators have the highest level of privileges for a user. In addition to having access to all features enabled by izyGlam, they can create and delete tasks on the kanban, create or delete users (thus defining new users with the administrator role, granting them extended permissions to monitor and adjust operational settings). This feature ensures increased security by limiting access to critical features only to authorized users, ensuring consistent and compliant management.
DOCUMENTATION.ROLEGIVE2: The User page offers complete account management, from creation to role assignment. Easy account creation facilitates user integration, while role assignment ensures precise control over permissions and responsibilities. This strategic approach to account management contributes to the effective and secure use of izyGlam's AMR platform, promoting seamless collaboration within the team.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTYPE1: The Export page offers a variety of export types, allowing users to obtain specific information about missions, cancellations, and deleted dollies. These detailed reports provide an in-depth view of past activities, enabling thorough analysis and informed decision-making.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTMISSIONS1: Exporting the Missions Report allows users to generate a detailed listing of completed missions. This report provides comprehensive visibility into missions accomplished by autonomous robots, including details such as routes taken, schedules, and mission statuses.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTANNULATIONS1: Exporting the Cancellations Report provides an overview of deleted tasks, either by an administrator or completed by a user with justification. Each cancellation is documented, mentioning the person initiating the cancellation. This feature offers a clear trace of changes made to missions, helping understand the reasons behind each cancellation.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTDELETEDDOLLIES1: Exporting the Deleted Dollies Report provides detailed reports on dollies that have been deleted via the mobile application. This feature offers visibility into actions taken regarding dollies, facilitating asset management and understanding changes in warehouse configuration.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTPARAM1: The export procedure begins with the precise selection of parameters. Users can specify start and end dates to target the export period. This parameter customization allows extracting only necessary data, avoiding information overload and facilitating analysis of the generated reports.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTAPK1: In addition to exporting reports, the Export page offers the ability to download the latest versions of APKs for tablets and mobiles. This feature ensures that users always have the latest and optimized versions of applications, ensuring a consistent and up-to-date user experience.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTAPK2: The Export page offers an extensive range of export types to meet specific user needs. Detailed reports on missions, cancellations, and deleted dollies provide in-depth information. The export procedure, with parameter selection and APK download, offers a comprehensive and adaptable experience, meeting the tracking and management requirements of each user.
DOCUMENTATION.ADMININTRO: The 'Kanban Administration' section provides complete control over the rules for automatic task creation on the kanban for each item, as well as return locations based on packaging defined in the 'items' file. This essential part of izyGlam's  platform allows administrators to customize kanban-related processes to align with the specific needs of the warehouse.
DOCUMENTATION.IMPORTDATA1: The data import function enables efficient updating of application information by importing an .xlsx file. This feature provides valuable flexibility to quickly integrate changes in kanban configuration, whether to adjust rules for automatic task creation or to update return locations based on packaging. Administrators can thus ensure that the kanban always reflects the latest operational specifications.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTDATA1: Data export is a crucial function for archiving or later reuse of information contained in the application. Administrators can export kanban rules, return locations, or other relevant data in .xlsx format. This feature ensures complete traceability of configurations and rules defined in the application, offering a backup and restoration option when needed.
DOCUMENTATION.EXPORTDATA2: The 'Kanban Administration' section represents the control center for defining kanban operation rules and implementing adjustments based on evolving operational needs. The ability to import and export data ensures smooth and responsive kanban management, allowing administrators to maintain an optimal configuration aligned with warehouse requirements.
